---
title: "My first weeks in MDS"
author: "Raghav Haralalka"
date: 2026-09-13
---

To be honest, I didn't even have a proper first few weeks in MDS. Mainly due to VISA delays from getting the approval to geting the VISA stamped and thus, arriving late.

While at home waiting for the VISA, I had coordinated with the Professors to get an idea of what I need to do to stay in track for completing the course on time. By doing this I could complete the week 1 assignments on time.

When week 2 arrived, I had just got the approval of my VISA and could travel as soon as I get back the stamped passport. This happened on Wednesday and I reached campus on Friday. Once I arrived, I immediately started working on the assignments but since I couldn't attend any of the lectures, it took me some time to get accustomed to the week 2 concepts of 523, 511 and 551 due to which I took a lot of time to complete them even with the help of lecture notes and some use of AI. 

Overall, I am happy I finally made it here and can now go with the flow rather than playing catch up.
